sections.title: What You'll Learn
sections.content:
Ready to learn **The for Loop**?

Here's what we'll cover:

• Counter-controlled loops
• Why this matters for your coding journey
• Hands-on examples you can try

sections.title: Core Concepts
sections.content:
Think of **The for Loop** like building blocks. 

Every great program starts with small, simple pieces. This is one of those essential pieces!

• Start simple, then build up
• Practice makes it click
• Don't worry if it takes time - totally normal!

sections.title: Code Examples
Key Points
points: The for loop combines initialization, condition, and update in one line
The initialization runs once; the condition is checked before each iteration; the update runs after each iteration
The for loop is ideal when the number of iterations is known in advance
The loop variable declared in the for header is scoped to the loop body

sections.title: Summary
sections.content: The for Loop - Counter-controlled loops. Master basics before advancing. Practice with the examples. Builds foundation for what's next.
